item.title: Royal Oak's new parking system wins over residents and businesses
item.description: Royal Oak's switch to ParkMobile at the start of the year is getting positive reviews from residents and business owners who say it's simpler and more user-friendly than the previous system.

item.title: Tigers agree to 3 year, $115 million contract with left-handed pitcher Framber Valdez
item.description: The Detroit Tigers have made a free agency splash just a week before Spring Training begins, landing left-hander Framber Valdez, according to ESPN's Jeff Passan.

item.title: Eastpointe mother warns of sledding dangers after daughter's severe injuries
item.description: An Eastpointe mother is warning other parents about the hidden dangers of sledding after her 10-year-old daughter suffered severe injuries in an accident at a local park.
